description: MailboxRole::to_wire_str() is defined in jmap-mail-types, the same crate that defines MailboxRole. Within the defining crate, #[non_exhaustive] does NOT suppress exhaustive match warnings, so adding a new variant without updating to_wire_str() is a compile error — not a runtime panic or silently wrong behavior. The old role_to_wire() function was a free function in mail-server which matched externally against a non_exhaustive enum and was forced to use an unreachable!() wildcard arm. This is the correct way to provide an infallible wire-format conversion for a non_exhaustive enum.
title: MailboxRole::to_wire_str() exhaustive match in defining crate is correct design
